primary: Each of3 locked independent training seeds must improve full71 paired mean L1 by at least3% against every original frozen baseline; identify strongest baseline conservatively. All rows and failures retained.

uncertainty.seed_mean: Resample identical71 groups jointly across all3 seeds; do not pool213 seed-by-image rows as independent
uncertainty.report: Per-seed paired intervals and seed-level range; inconclusive results are not proof of goal success

guardrails.execution: Maintain strongest original baseline execution; report failures and common-executable comparison
guardrails.nonoperation: Report empty/zero, pixel identity, near identity<1/255, edit-L1 distribution and substantive-edit union comparison; do not manufacture gains via fallback or no-op
guardrails.instruction: Frozen global brightness/warmth/saturation proxies, unassessable requests excluded from pass counts; per-seed compared with strongest baseline; broader anonymized visual review

future_test_policy: No test-driven model/recipe selection. If unsuccessful or inconclusive, inspected71 are regression data for future work, requiring a new independent confirmation set.
pending: Final model identities and development gate must be frozen before this evaluator can run. No inference performed by preparation.
